RESUMABLE COW ZSTD ASSET PIPELINE & STATEFUL PURE-HTTP ONBOARDING PROTOCOL AUDIT
nankhor/kite-pack (CoW ZSTD + AVA1 Resumable Pipeline) + duwqijlk/muse-protocol (Stateful HTTP + vm/wake Gate)
📦 nankhor/kite-pack (★55 · GPL-3.0 · Rust + Tauri 2 + C kite-helper.elf)
1. Crash-Resumable 5-Step Pipeline & Read-Only Console Telemetry
• kite-pipeline persists every step transition (pack → trash original → AVA1 send → DLC → cleanup)
• Read-only inspection of /user/appmeta, /user/app, /user/patch & /user/addcont (never blind-sends)
2. Copy-on-Write (CoW) DLC/Backport Folding & Integrity Guard
CoW Clone → APFS / btrfs / XFS zero-copy clone before folding addcontN & dlc_emu.ini
PS5 Dump Forge → ZSTD compression (--level fast|medium|max; folder/exfat/ffpkg/ffpfs)
kite-helper.elf → AVA1 C node on port 9021; writes strictly scoped to /data & /mnt
--delete-original → Moves source to Trash ONLY after packed output verified & source unchanged
3. Cross-Platform CLI & Tauri 2 Desktop Architecture
• 6 Rust workspace crates (kite-pipeline, kite-forge, kite-session, kite-ps5, kite-cli) + C helper
• Bundled dlc_emu 0.3 (GPL-3.0) automatically injects fakelib/ modules only when dump lacks its own
• Rejects invalid inputs early (PS4 titles, retail/patch PKGs, standalone DLC, or already-packed dirs)
Architectural Takeaway for AI Solution Architects:
When building multi-enclave edge model/asset distribution pipelines, never mutate golden directories
in place: clone via APFS/btrfs/XFS copy-on-write, fold overlays into the clone, checkpoint every
pipeline state transition to disk, and pre-query target inventory (/user/appmeta) before streaming.
🔐 duwqijlk/muse-protocol (★952 · Python Pure-HTTP Stateful Protocol Client)
1. Hidden Server State Gates Uncovered by Packet-Level Diffing
• 11-step state machine: /restart ({resume:false}) → OTP → register-completion → session/bootstrap
• Parses Next Flight dynamic disclosure (HATCH_ROW_v0) + detects resolvedDestination/isGeoGated
2. Why Naive HTTP Clients Get False "invalid" & 403 Errors
POST /api/hatch/vm/wake → Mandatory (wake_trigger="mount", away_ms=0) or redeem returns invalid!
confirm-otp → Requires supports_muse_link_transparency: true
accept-tos → Must echo live Next Flight disclosureText (never hardcoded strings)
Memory-Only Tokens → frl_access_token & hatch_sess (~886 chars) never written to disk
3. Sticky-Proxy Scheduler & Idempotent OTP Polling (musepy/runner.py)
• Exclusive per-worker sticky proxy claim/release with max_per_ip=6 cap & pre-send 3x proxy retry
• Halts entire batch immediately on post-OTP business rejection or region_waitlist (zero email waste)
• Idempotent OTP poller only accepts 6-digit codes timestamped strictly after send_otp (45s/0.6s)
Architectural Takeaway for AI Solution Architects:
Modern web backends enforce implicit state-machine preconditions (like requiring vm/wake before
invite redemption or echoing RSC/Next Flight dynamic TOS payloads). Pure-HTTP state machines with
pre-send vs post-send retry split and in-memory-only credentials eliminate headless browser overhead.
